events.title: US carries out defensive strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island, officials say
events.verification_status: headline timestamp seen in search result; article body not retrieved (HTTP 401)

claims.text: A US official said the United States carried out strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island and described them as limited, not a return to major combat.
claims.attribution: Reuters, citing an unnamed US official

claims.text: Another official described the strikes as defensive measures against Iranian surface-to-air missiles used against US assets.
claims.attribution: Reuters, citing a second unnamed official

claims.text: CENTCOM had not responded, and Iranian state media IRNA reported several explosions on Qeshm.
claims.attribution: Reuters account of CENTCOM non-response and IRNA

scenario_conditions: If a Hormuz disruption is independently verified, oil, shipping, and risk-premium channels can matter for US equities and Korea. No magnitude is estimated from this headline.
An anonymous official's description of a limited defensive strike is not evidence of a resumed full-scale war.

events.title: US military carries out new targeted strikes on Iran as Tehran's leaders weigh mediator's proposals
events.verification_status: AP headline and lead seen via search; page fetch failed, so the exact clock is unknown

claims.text: President Trump said the US military carried out new limited strikes on an Iranian air-defense system and described the action as minor.
claims.attribution: Associated Press reporting of Trump's remarks to reporters

claims.text: Trump said an anti-aircraft device was knocked out in about 15 minutes, or maybe five.
claims.attribution: President Trump, as quoted in the AP lead

claims.text: Iranian state media reported two explosions in the Suza area of Qeshm Island, in the Strait of Hormuz.
claims.attribution: Iranian state media, as reported by AP

scenario_conditions: A reported strike inside the Strait of Hormuz is a conditional energy and shipping risk for the next session. It does not by itself set an index return.
Trump's 'minor' description and ongoing mediator talks are reported de-escalation language, not confirmation that the risk has ended.
